maria (People Ops): Quick heads up — were launching the Q3 Gratitude Kiosk field kits for hybrid pop-ups. Goal: ship kits to 6 offices next week and assemble remote care packages for ~45 distributed folks. I need volunteers for packing (Wed morning), and someone to confirm vendor pickup window (Thu AM). Spreadsheet with addresses & counts: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

sam (Logistics): I can do packing Wed 9–11am @HQ. How many kits per office?

jordan (Events): Per latest signups: SF 30, NYC 25, LON 18, BER 12, TOR 8, SEA 10. Remote kits: 45. Total kits = 148.

alex (Finance): Budget check — what's the per-kit spend? Do gift cards inflate the budget?

maria (People Ops): Target cap is $12/kit excluding shipping. Remote folks get a $10 e-gift card + thank-you postcard. Office kits get physical $5 spot-award tokens + stickers/confetti + 2 promo postcards. Were covering extra gift-card cost from team recognition budget.

lucy (Remote Ops): For remote kits I can prep the e-gift codes and batch-send. Need a list of emails column in the sheet (col D?).

maria (People Ops): Yep column D is email. Please add any alt addresses by EOD. Also volunteers — we need 4 packers at HQ, 2 at NYC staging. Who can help? @here

sam (Logistics): I have 2 people from Ops + one temp. Need volunteer names for two more. Will book a 4ft packing table and labels.

jordan (Events): I'll bring label printer and tape. Packing list (final):
```
- 1 x local spot-award token ($5)
- 1 x thank-you postcard
- 2 x promo postcards
- 1 x mini confetti pack
- 5 x stickers
- 1 x packing slip
```

maria (People Ops): Shipping labels: vendor will schedule pickup Thu 3–5pm. Sam — please run labels through this command on the label pc: `lp -o fit-to-page gratitude-labels.pdf`

sam (Logistics): Noted. I'll confirm pickup window with vendor and post tracking once pickup is scheduled.

alex (Finance): Please keep receipts in the sheet upload tab so we can code to GL 4-215. Also confirm total spend before we finalize.

maria (People Ops): Will do. Estimated spend after vendor discounts ~ $1,600. If it balloons >$2k we loop finance.

lucy (Remote Ops): For remote e-gift card fulfillment I need a CSV of name,email,amount by Tue noon. I'll run the batch and DM confirmation.

jordan (Events): Volunteer roster so far: sam, me, maria, tasha (Ops), rafael (Events). Need one more for HQ.

maria (People Ops): Thanks — @emily from People Ops volunteered in DM. All good. Last ask: can someone proof the packing slip wording? I wrote: "Thanks for all you do — drop a quick shoutout into #gratitude when you spot someone deserving!"

alex (Finance): Wording fine. Add small note: "Keep receipts for tax purposes" on internal copy only.

kudos-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Pack kits — Wed 9am @HQ" (automated). :bell:

maria (People Ops): Perfect. I'll update the sheet with final counts and post a short checklist tomorrow morning. Appreciate the help team :heart:
